# osk.exe is all Rust (osk-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/osk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# keyboard.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/keyboard/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/main.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/settings.rs)
add_cargo_module(osk osk-cargo osk.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE osk-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
